cleaning.name: Chimney Cleaning
cleaning.alt: Fireplace after a Northmark chimney sweep, floor clean
cleaning.fixes: Soot and creosote building up in the flue.
cleaning.benefit: A cleaner-burning fireplace, and no mess left behind.

inspection.name: Chimney Inspection
inspection.alt: Chimney inspection report with camera photos
inspection.fixes: Not knowing what state the flue and firebox are in.
inspection.benefit: Camera photos and a 19-point report, free at your home.

repair.name: Chimney Repair
repair.alt: Repaired brick chimney above the roofline
repair.fixes: Cracked crowns, damaged brick, water getting in.
repair.benefit: Fixed once, with materials matched to your home.

caps.name: Chimney Caps
caps.alt: Stainless steel chimney cap fitted on a flue
caps.fixes: Rain, snow, birds and animals getting into the flue.
caps.benefit: Caps measured to your flue, in stainless so they last.

liners.name: Chimney Liners
liners.fixes: A cracked, damaged or missing flue liner.
liners.benefit: Heat and exhaust vented the way they should be.

masonry.name: Masonry & Tuckpointing
masonry.fixes: Crumbling mortar, loose or spalling brick, a leaning or leaking chimney.
masonry.benefit: Repointing, brick replacement and rebuilds, matched to your home.

flashing.name: Flashing & Waterproofing
flashing.alt: Chimney flashing sealed at the roofline
flashing.fixes: Water stains near the chimney, leaks that show up after rain.
flashing.benefit: Flashing resealed or replaced, and the masonry sealed against water.

maintenance.name: Chimney Maintenance
maintenance.fixes: Small problems turning into expensive ones.
maintenance.benefit: A yearly sweep and check, so nothing is a surprise.

fireplace.name: Fireplace Repair
fireplace.alt: Clean fireplace and hearth after a Northmark visit
fireplace.fixes: Fireboxes, dampers, smoke chambers, gas fireplaces that will not light or stay lit.
fireplace.benefit: Wood and gas, with safety issues explained in plain language.
